panels.title: Facts
panels.description: Identity facts. Sources: chain `ValidatorJoin` event (since, initial stake), explorer `/address` (status, operator, owner), portal roster (portal link, identity completeness).

targets.root_selector:
def h2i: ascii_downcase | reduce (explode[]) as $c (0; .*16 + (if $c>=97 then $c-87 else $c-48 end));
[.result[] | select((.data | ascii_downcase | .[90:130]) == "${node_hex}")] | first // {} | if .blockTimestamp then [{fact: "Validator since", value: ((.blockTimestamp | ltrimstr("0x") | h2i) | strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M UTC"))}, {fact: "Joined with", value: (((.data | ltrimstr("0x") | .[128:192] | h2i) / 1e18 | floor | tostring) + " GEN self stake")}] else [{fact: "Validator since", value: "no join event found"}] end
.validator | [{fact: "Status", value: .status}, {fact: "Operator", value: (.operator_address | ascii_downcase)}, {fact: "Owner", value: (.owner_address | ascii_downcase)}]

[.[] | select(.node == ("${node}" | ascii_downcase))] | map([{fact: "Portal", value: (if .linked == true then ("linked" + (if (.account_name // "") != "" then " — " + .account_name else "" end)) elif .linked == false then "NOT LINKED" else "-" end)}, {fact: "On-chain identity", value: ([(if (.moniker // "") == "" then "moniker" else empty end), (if (.logo_uri // "") == "" then "logo" else empty end), (if .has_description == true then empty else "description" end)] | if length == 0 then "complete" else "missing: " + join(", ") end)}]) | add // []

panels.title: Chain
panels.description: Live on-chain participation, same rule as the network board: in the selectable set = active; quarantined until epoch N; permanently quarantined = no longer participating; otherwise not participating. Source: staking `epoch()`, `selectableValidators()`, `validatorBanned(node)`.

targets.root_selector:
def h2i: ascii_downcase | reduce (explode[]) as $c (0; .*16 + (if $c>=97 then $c-87 else $c-48 end));
(map(select(.id==1))[0].result | ltrimstr("0x") | h2i) as $ep
| (map(select(.id==2))[0].result | ltrimstr("0x") | .[128:] | [range(0; length/64) as $i | .[$i*64+24:$i*64+64]]) as $sel
| (map(select(.id==3))[0].result | ltrimstr("0x")) as $b
| ($b[64:128] | if . == "" then 0 else h2i end) as $until | (($b[128:192] // "") | if . == "" then 0 else h2i end) as $perm
| [{chain: (if $perm > 0 then "red|No longer participating" elif $until > $ep then "orange|Quarantined until epoch \($until)" elif ($sel | index("${node_hex}")) != null then "green|Active (epoch \($ep))" else "red|Not participating" end)}]

defaults.noValue: No data
